notes:
I couldn't write these notes. My research tool stopped working on the first call. I tried twice, and each time it said I had no tool calls left for this turn. So I couldn't open any pages: not Enduring Word, Precept Austin, Bible Hub (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit), Wesley's Notes, NET Bible, Bible Odyssey, New Advent or anything else on your list.

Your rules say to report only what the pages I read actually say, give a URL for every point, and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. Since I read nothing, any notes I wrote now would come from memory. They would break those rules and could put wrong sources in your commentary. So I'm leaving every verse blank rather than guessing.

**What I meant to read, so you can start the research again:**
- **Traditional reading, verse by verse:**
  - enduringword.com/bible-commentary/ecclesiastes-1/
  - preceptaustin.org (Ecclesiastes 1 commentary)
  - biblehub.com/commentaries/ecclesiastes/1-1.htm through 1-18.htm (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit, Barnes)
  - studylight.org (Clarke, Henry, Poole)
- **Differences between Protestant traditions:**
  - Wesley's Notes on Ecclesiastes (wesley.nnu.edu)
  - Ligonier, The Gospel Coalition and Monergism (Reformed views on *hebel* and on whether Solomon wrote the book)
  - Desiring God and GTY (Baptist)
  - 1517.org and LCMS (Lutheran, the "under the sun" law/gospel angle)
  - Seedbed (Wesleyan)
- **Other views:**
  - NET Bible notes on *hebel* in v. 2 and on "Qoheleth" in v. 1
  - Bible Odyssey on who wrote the book and when
  - New Advent's Catholic Encyclopedia article "Ecclesiastes", plus Jerome and the Church Fathers
  - Catholic.com and OCA
  - Got Questions, if it covers popular modern teaching

If you send the request again in a new message, I'll work through these sources and write the verse-by-verse notes with a URL for each point.
